name: Catherine Elizabeth Vance Montgomery
extra_bullets: Chaired the company's capital committee and set the review process every project above $250,000 now goes through
Built a supplier development program with eight key suppliers that cut late material deliveries by 40% in two years
Started a maintenance apprenticeship with the local community college that has placed 14 technicians so far
Wrote the plant's first preventive maintenance schedule for the paint line and stamping presses
cover_letter_paragraph: Outside the plants, I've spent the last five years on the board of a regional manufacturing group, working on apprenticeships and workforce training. It keeps me close to the hiring problems every plant manager in the region shares, and it has given me a network of community colleges and training partners I'd be glad to bring to Tennwick.

extra_reference.name: James Whitcombe
extra_reference.relationship: Board chair, works with me on capital planning
